A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same msf-CNN work and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. All substantive material can be matched, including v1 Appendix F relocated to v2 Section 9.

before.justification: Section 8 and Tables 2, 3, and 5 report original on-device measurements of peak RAM usage and inference latency for three CNN workloads on multiple microcontrollers.

after.justification: Section 8 and Tables 2, 3, and 5 retain the original microcontroller experiments and their measured RAM and latency outcomes.

M1.justification: Sections 3-7 retain the same DAG representation, constrained fusion optimizers, H-cache scheme, and iterative global pooling and dense-layer computation. No algorithmic component or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Sections 6.3 and 8 and Appendix E retain the same MCU inference workloads and ARM Cortex-M, Xtensa, and RISC-V environments. No evaluated dataset, application task, or distinct test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains vanilla inference and the early-layer-fusion heuristic. Tables 2 and 5 and Figure 4 retain vanilla inference, MCUNetV2, and StreamNet, identified as StreamNet-2D in Section 8.

E3.justification: The three model configurations and input sizes, compute-overhead thresholds of 1.1-1.5 plus the unconstrained case, RAM budgets of 16-256 kB, evaluation metrics, and MCU settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Sections 6.3 and 8.1-8.3 retain the same minimum-memory and RAM/compute-budget trade-off analyses. No ablation, robustness test, sensitivity analysis, or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for the experiments. Numerical outcomes retain the same reporting practice.

E6.justification: The results in Tables 1-3 and 5 and Figure 4 are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains msf-CNN peak RAM values of 8.56, 15.368, and 51.164 kB for the three models, with identical comparator values and latency findings.

T1.justification: Equations 1-15, the optimization definitions and assumptions, the cache/MAC derivations in Appendices B-C, and the complexity argument and induction in Appendix D are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about broader fusion choices, memory savings, polynomial search, and deployment across MCU architectures. The conclusion is renumbered without changing its claims.

C2.justification: The interpretations of memory-latency trade-offs and flash-access overhead remain unchanged. The limitations concerning one output element per iteration, H-cache-only search, and CNN-only coverage move verbatim from Appendix F to Section 9.

D1.justification: Section 7 retains microTVM v0.16.0 and RIOT-ML implementation details. Appendix E retains identical hardware specifications, and the code-availability statement and repository destination are unchanged.

R1.justification: All 44 references and the substantive positioning against prior work remain unchanged. The new NeurIPS 2025 citation notice updates this paper's publication information rather than its relationship to earlier research.

P1.justification: Appendix F, 'Limitations,' becomes main-text Section 9, 'Discussion,' with identical paragraphs; Related Work and Conclusion are renumbered. Author affiliations, contact presentation, publication information, and appendix cross-references receive limited edits.

P2.justification: Figure 4 moves above Tables 2 and 3 on page 8. A first-page citation banner and reformatted author block alter pagination, but all four figures and five tables retain their substantive displays and contents.

improvement.justification: Moving the unchanged limitations into Section 9 makes them more visible, but the method, theoretical support, experiments, results, and reproducibility information remain identical. The publication-information updates and limited layout changes leave overall paper quality effectively unchanged.
